title: tdh.util.signalMonitor.ui~
description: `tdh.util.signalMonitor.ui~` monitors an input signal and reports sampled values plus amplitude in linear, Pd RMS, and digital full-scale formats for use elsewhere. The signal is passed through, and separate float inputs control the polling interval and monitoring state, with values above 0 turning monitoring on and values at or below 0 turning it off.
